briefing_zh:
今天最值得关注的变化，是 foundation model 训练与 agent 训练都在把「阶段」重新解释为数据与反馈的调度问题。**Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm** 将 pretraining、SFT 与 RL 统一成 likelihood-based training；**A-RSI** 则用训练动态决定何时刷新可验证任务，而不是盲目追加 self-generated data。两者共同指向一个更一般的结论：self-improvement 的瓶颈不只是生成更多经验，而是识别哪些经验仍有学习信号、怎样保证监督独立可验。

评测侧正在从排行榜分数转向 distribution、coverage 与 complete task success。**Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty** 把 benchmark 看作 difficulty 上的经验测度，揭示 measure mismatch 和 coverage gaps；**Co-Design Bench** 与 **DAYJOB: Tax** 则分别用真实 coding session 和复杂专业文件检验 agent 是否能完整满足多重要求。最强模型在 Co-Design Bench 上平均完成 69.9% criteria，却只完整解决 26.4% tasks，这再次说明 partial credit 很容易掩盖长程执行中的尾部失败。

面向交互环境，今天的信号横跨 world model、robotics 与 multi-agent。**L3G-World** 用 latent 3D Gaussian memory 将长期一致性和 9 FPS 实时生成结合起来；**Probing Spatial State Representations** 证明可读出当前场景并不等于能维持 object persistence 或支持行动；**Evolving Agent Teams** 和 YC 的游戏实验则显示，团队重组、持久化经验与角色分工可能帮助 agents 逃离单 agent 的 local optimum，但也会放大协议僵化和集体失控风险。

开源与社区热点更贴近可部署系统：**Mika** 把 Android App 操作放进后台虚拟屏，直接触及 mobile CUA 的并发使用体验；**BLA**、**Grim Prompter** 与 OpenAI CPU-cache side channel 讨论共同说明，agent security 已从 prompt 层进入 binary、tool permission、VM isolation 与 covert channel。最现实的工程启示是：agent harness 的成本、权限和观察通道都必须成为一等公民，而不是模型外部不可见的 plumbing。
briefing_en:
The most important shift today is that both foundation-model training and agent training are reframing stages as problems of scheduling data and feedback. **Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm** casts pretraining, SFT, and RL as likelihood-based training, while **A-RSI** uses training dynamics to decide when to refresh independently verifiable tasks instead of blindly adding self-generated data. Together they suggest that self-improvement depends less on producing ever more experience than on detecting when experience still carries learning signal and keeping supervision auditable.

Evaluation is moving from leaderboard totals toward distributions, coverage, and complete task success. **Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty** treats a benchmark as an empirical measure over difficulty and exposes measure mismatch and coverage gaps; **Co-Design Bench** and **DAYJOB: Tax** test agents on real coding sessions and messy professional records. The strongest model on Co-Design Bench satisfies 69.9% of criteria on average but completes only 26.4% of tasks, showing how partial credit can conceal long-horizon tail failures.

Across interactive environments, the signal spans world models, robotics, and multi-agent systems. **L3G-World** combines latent 3D Gaussian memory with real-time generation at 9 FPS; **Probing Spatial State Representations** shows that decoding the visible scene does not imply object persistence or actionable state; and **Evolving Agent Teams** plus YC's game experiments suggest that restructuring, persistent experience, and role specialization can escape single-agent local optima while also creating brittle protocols and collective-risk modes.

Open-source and community attention is converging on deployable systems. **Mika** operates Android apps on a hidden background display, directly addressing concurrent-use friction in mobile CUA, while **BLA**, **Grim Prompter**, and the CPU-cache side-channel story push agent security beyond prompts into binaries, tool permissions, VM isolation, and covert channels. The practical lesson is that harness cost, authority, and observation paths must become first-class design objects rather than invisible plumbing around the model.
viral_analysis_zh: 今天最可能出圈的是 **Mika**：一句「后台替你操作手机、你还能继续用前台」同时给出可感知痛点、直观 demo 和 APK，1889 stars 的快速增长说明 mobile CUA 终于被包装成普通用户能理解的产品。研究侧最可能持续发酵的是 **Evolving Agent Teams**，因为它用 production kernel 的硬指标把 multi-agent 从角色扮演叙事推进到可验证优化。
viral_analysis_en: **Mika** is today's strongest viral candidate: the promise that an agent can operate apps on a hidden display while the user keeps using the phone combines a legible pain point, visual demos, and an installable APK, helping it reach 1,889 stars quickly. On the research side, **Evolving Agent Teams** is likely to travel because production-kernel speedups turn multi-agent coordination from a role-play narrative into verifiable optimization results.

huggingface_papers.title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
huggingface_papers.tldr: Intrinsic Distribution Matching augments distribution-matching distillation with explicit feature mean and per-coordinate standard-deviation constraints. It uses the generator's EMA copy as the feature source, avoiding a separate external encoder while retaining the full reverse-KL correction. On two-network-evaluation text-to-image generation, it reports 94.25% Chinese and 90.20% English LongText-Bench scores on Z-Image-Turbo and Qwen-Image experiments. The result matters because it improves prompt-detail fidelity in the latency-critical one- and few-step regime without adding a heavyweight teacher feature stack.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Intrinsic Distribution Matching 在 distribution-matching distillation 上加入显式的 feature mean 与逐维 standard deviation 约束。它直接使用 generator 的 EMA 副本提供特征，不需要额外 external encoder，同时保留完整 reverse-KL 修正。在 Z-Image-Turbo 与 Qwen-Image 的两步生成实验中，中文和英文 LongText-Bench 分别达到 94.25% 与 90.20%。其价值在于不引入重型 teacher feature stack，就提升了 one/few-step 图像生成对 prompt 细节的遵循。
huggingface_papers.authors: Deyuan Liu, Yansen Han, Kaiwen Zheng, Jun Xie, Jiacheng Liu, Zhenglin Cheng, Peng Sun, Jintao Zhang, Jianguo Li, Tao Lin

huggingface_papers.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
huggingface_papers.tldr: A-RSI separates when to acquire new experience from how to obtain reliable answers. It watches reward variation and training accuracy to refresh a task pool only when its learning signal declines, while model-authored programs generate multimodal tasks with independently checkable references. The loop uses no external training examples or human-written labels and raises the reported eleven-benchmark average from 57.77 to 61.05 with 800 fresh tasks. This makes recursive self-improvement more credible by coupling adaptive curricula with verification rather than self-consistency alone.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: A-RSI 将「何时获取新经验」与「如何得到可靠答案」拆开处理。它监控 reward variation 与训练 accuracy，只在学习信号衰减时刷新 task pool；同时由模型编写的程序生成 multimodal tasks 和可独立核验的 reference answers。整个循环不使用外部训练样本或人工标签，用 800 个新任务将 11 项 benchmark 平均分从 57.77 提升到 61.05。它的重要性在于把 adaptive curriculum 与 verification 绑定，而不是仅依赖 self-consistency。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yu Liu, Youxing Li, Yuedong Tan, Zhiwei Yang, Zihan Su, Hanqi Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Libin Liao, Zihao Wan, Chenxu Wu, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Yanbing Liu, Ziheng Chen, Pei Fu, Radu Timofte, Zongwei Wu, Nicu Sebe, Barnabas Poczos, Jian Luan

huggingface_papers.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
huggingface_papers.tldr: This work formalizes a benchmark as an empirical measure over item difficulty rather than a neutral bag of questions. It identifies measure mismatch, where sampled difficulty differs from the intended target, and coverage gaps, where local regions cannot reveal model progress. An analysis of 25 benchmarks across seven domains finds both failures to be common, and BenchFill rewrites items toward missing difficulty regions. The framework is important because it turns vague complaints about leaderboard representativeness into measurable diagnostics and a concrete repair operation.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 这项工作把 benchmark 形式化为 difficulty 上的经验测度，而不是一组中性的题目集合。它区分 measure mismatch，即实际采样难度偏离目标分布，以及 coverage gaps，即某些难度区间缺题、无法观测局部进步。作者分析 7 个领域的 25 个 benchmarks，发现两类问题都很普遍，并用 BenchFill 将题目重写到缺失难度区域。其价值是把「排行榜不具代表性」从模糊批评变成可计算的诊断与修复动作。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yifan Sun, Naicheng Yu, Jiawen Gong, Jingyan Shen, Huan Zhang

huggingface_papers.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
huggingface_papers.tldr: WorkFactory converts professional intents into coherent executable tasks through an information-support graph. Probe executions detect missing or inconsistent dependencies and repair the environment before teacher trajectories become supervision. The pipeline creates 112,686 tasks across 612 occupations, and WorkPilot-35B-A3B improves from 879 to 1,565 Elo on GDPval-AA v2.1. The contribution matters because task-environment validity, not just model scale, becomes an explicit data-quality gate for training working agents.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: WorkFactory 通过 information-support graph 将专业意图转成信息依赖完整、可执行的任务。它先用 probe executions 发现缺失或矛盾的依赖并修复环境，再把 teacher trajectories 用作监督。该流程生成覆盖 612 个职业的 112,686 个任务，WorkPilot-35B-A3B 在 GDPval-AA v2.1 上从 879 Elo 提升到 1565 Elo。它的重要性在于把 task environment 的有效性而非单纯模型规模，变成 working agent 训练的数据质量门禁。
huggingface_papers.authors: Ziyang Zeng, Tingyang Chen, Jia Deng, Qiyao Wang, Shuo Tang, Yike Yang, Tao Ren, Wayne Xin Zhao, Feng Chang, Jujie He, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai

huggingface_papers.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
huggingface_papers.tldr: Co-Design Bench evaluates coding agents on 273 multimodal editing and repository tasks derived from 37,463 deduplicated requests in real user sessions. It uses 2,331 hidden expert criteria and a judge-then-refute protocol that checks source, browser, visual, and interaction evidence without requiring gold code. The best of ten model endpoints satisfies 69.9% of criteria on average but fully completes only 26.4% of tasks. This exposes the gap between locally plausible edits and complete requirement satisfaction in realistic collaborative coding.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Co-Design Bench 从真实用户 session 的 37,463 条去重请求中构建 273 个 multimodal editing 与 repository tasks。它使用 2,331 条隐藏 expert criteria，并以 judge-then-refute 协议核查 source、browser、visual 和 interaction evidence，无需 gold code。十个 model endpoints 中最强者平均满足 69.9% criteria，却只完整完成 26.4% tasks。该结果直接揭示了局部看似合理的修改与真实协作 coding 中完整满足需求之间的差距。
huggingface_papers.authors: Xilin Wei, Shengyuan Ding, Xinyu Fang, Tiancheng Gu, Yuchi Wang, Zhixun Li, Ziyu Liu, Yuhang Zang, Weixiang Yu, Cheng Lu, Chonggao Sun, Tong Zhou, Dahua Lin, Hang Zhang, Shuai Bai, Dayiheng Liu

alphaxiv_papers.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: The paper derives pretraining, midtraining, SFT, and suitable RL objectives as maximum-likelihood fitting to different target distributions. A single trainer can therefore mix static examples with reward-selected model generations, making stage boundaries a data-mixture policy rather than a change of algorithm. Controlled and real-world experiments report better accuracy-compute tradeoffs, broader task coverage, and stronger continual-learning initialization. The key idea is strategically important because it collapses a fragmented model-development stack into one optimization language while retaining stage-like curricula as a special case.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 论文把 pretraining、midtraining、SFT 和一类 RL objectives 都推导为对不同 target distributions 的 maximum-likelihood fitting。这样同一个 trainer 就能混合 static examples 与 reward-selected generations，阶段边界变成 data-mixture policy，而非更换算法。受控与真实实验显示 accuracy-compute trade-off、task coverage 和 continual-learning 起点均有改善。核心意义是用统一优化语言压缩碎片化训练栈，同时仍把传统 staged curriculum 保留为特例。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: This study probes ten frozen visual representations under streaming egocentric observations at four levels: visible structure, object persistence, predictive update, and actionability. Strong readout of the current scene does not reliably imply memory of off-screen objects, transfer from predicted to real features, or progress under a supplied goal. Camera-pose information supports persistence and actionability, while visible-scene readout better predicts future-feature recovery. The result matters for embodied agents because static perception scores can overstate whether a representation actually maintains and uses world state.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 这项研究在 streaming egocentric observations 下，对十种冻结视觉表示测试 visible structure、object persistence、predictive update 与 actionability 四个层级。能高质量读出当前场景，并不稳定意味着能记住视野外物体、让 predicted features 迁移到真实 reader，或在给定目标后持续推进。Camera-pose 信息更支撑 persistence 与 actionability，而 visible-scene readout 更关联 future-feature recovery。它提醒 embodied agent 研究：静态 perception 分数可能高估 representation 维护并使用 world state 的能力。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: The method represents a controller through examples of commanded actions and resulting robot motion, then conditions one policy on that interaction history. This prevents conflicting action semantics from being naively pooled across six controller types, gains, compliance settings, and embodiments. Real-world tests improve average success by 33 percentage points over naive pooling and retain roughly 50% success on unseen controller modes and gains. It offers a practical route to reuse heterogeneous robot data without pretending that identical action vectors have identical physical meaning.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: 该方法用「commanded actions 及其造成的 robot motion」示例表示 controller，再让统一 policy 对这段 interaction history 做 in-context adaptation。这样可避免在六类 controller、不同 gains、compliance 与 embodiment 之间直接混合相互冲突的 action semantics。真实机器人实验相比 naive pooling 平均 success 提升 33 个百分点，对 unseen controller modes 和 gains 仍约有 50% success。它提供了一条复用异构 robot data 的现实路径，而不假设相同 action vector 在不同控制器上具有相同物理含义。

alphaxiv_papers.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: L3G-World alternates a memory updater with a video diffusion transformer, storing VAE latent features directly inside a compact 3D Gaussian scene memory. Memory grows with explored spatial extent rather than video duration, and the renderer conditions the DiT in latent space without repeated RGB re-encoding. The system reports up to 38.6x fewer primitives, 3.2x faster updates, 359x faster memory rendering, and 9-FPS world generation. This is a meaningful systems step toward interactive world models that preserve long-horizon geometry without surrendering real-time control.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: L3G-World 让 memory updater 与 video diffusion transformer 交替工作，并把 VAE latent features 直接存入紧凑的 3D Gaussian scene memory。其 memory 随探索空间范围而非视频时长增长，renderer 直接在 latent space 为 DiT 提供条件，无需反复 RGB re-encoding。论文报告最多减少 38.6 倍 primitives、加速 3.2 倍 memory update、359 倍 memory rendering，并达到 9 FPS。对于既要长期几何一致性又要实时控制的 interactive world model，这是重要的 systems 进展。

alphaxiv_papers.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Evolving Agent Teams uses a supervisor to diagnose local optima and restructure specialized agents, while a persistent filesystem retains lessons, evolution history, and team artifacts. Under matched token budgets it beats strong coding-agent baselines, and with more budget it produces a CUDA kernel averaging 1.2x speedup over production FlashInfer MLA paged decode and winning 36 of 47 workloads. Gains also transfer to AMD and NVIDIA kernels, Apple-silicon serving, and robot manipulation. The work is notable because team topology becomes an adaptive search variable grounded by persistent evidence rather than a fixed role prompt.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Evolving Agent Teams 用 supervisor 诊断 local optima 并重组 specialized agents，同时通过 persistent filesystem 保存 lessons、evolution history 与 team artifacts。在相同 token budget 下它优于强 coding-agent baselines；扩展预算后，从零生成的 CUDA kernel 相比 production FlashInfer MLA paged decode 平均快 1.2 倍，并在 47 个 workloads 中赢下 36 个。收益还覆盖 AMD/NVIDIA kernels、Apple-silicon serving 与 robot manipulation。其关键在于把 team topology 变成由持久证据支撑的 adaptive search variable，而不是固定角色 prompt。

github_repos.name: wangzan101/Mika
github_repos.tldr: Mika is an Android agent that operates apps and a desktop-class browser on a hidden background display, allowing the foreground phone session to remain usable. It combines Accessibility-based control, a local Linux sandbox, BYO model endpoints, and an MCP bridge for delegating tasks from a computer. Sensitive actions such as payment remain gated on the physical phone, while requests go directly to the configured model provider. Its product insight is that mobile automation becomes more useful when agent execution does not monopolize the user's only screen.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Mika 是一个 Android agent，可在隐藏的后台屏上操作 App 与 desktop-class browser，因此用户仍能继续使用前台手机。它组合 Accessibility 控制、本地 Linux sandbox、可自选 model endpoint，以及供电脑端派发任务的 MCP bridge。付款等敏感动作仍必须在实体手机确认，请求则直接发往用户配置的模型服务商。其产品洞察是：只有当 agent execution 不独占用户唯一屏幕时，mobile automation 才真正可日常使用。

github_repos.name: qybaihe/bla
github_repos.tldr: BLA hardens shipped artifacts against automated reverse-engineering agents by inserting format-valid decoys, resource-exhaustion structures, and ambiguous analysis paths while preserving runtime behavior. It covers binaries and formats including Electron ASAR, WASM, JavaScript, SQLite, safetensors, and GGUF, with a CLI and MCP interface. The repository includes machine-readable empirical tests against a real reverse-engineering agent and clearly scopes which failures were actually observed. It is interesting because it treats agent-aware software defense as measurable adversarial systems engineering rather than prompt obfuscation.
github_repos.tldr_zh: BLA 通过植入 format-valid decoys、resource-exhaustion structures 与模糊分析路径，提升发布产物对自动 reverse-engineering agents 的抵抗力，同时保持 runtime behavior。它覆盖 Electron ASAR、WASM、JavaScript、SQLite、safetensors、GGUF 等格式，并提供 CLI 与 MCP interface。仓库给出了针对真实 reverse-engineering agent 的 machine-readable empirical tests，也明确限定哪些失败被实际观察到。它的意义在于把 agent-aware software defense 做成可测量的 adversarial systems engineering，而非 prompt 混淆。

github_repos.name: konlu/story-studio
github_repos.tldr: Story Studio packages topic selection, script writing, narration, ASR alignment, visual storyboarding, image generation, and editable Jianying project export into one agent skill. It includes more than 370 reference scripts, three visual systems, local timestamp alignment, and modular entry points for users who already have text or audio. The workflow is audio-first, using real subtitle timing rather than character-count estimates to place shots. Its appeal comes from delivering an editable production artifact instead of stopping at generated text or disconnected media assets.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Story Studio 将选题、文案、配音、ASR 对齐、视觉分镜、生图与可编辑剪映工程导出封装进一个 agent skill。它内置 370 多篇参考文案、三套视觉体系、本地时间戳对齐，并允许已有文稿或音频的用户从任意模块接力。工作流采用 audio-first，根据真实字幕时间而非字数估计安排镜头。其吸引力在于最终交付可继续编辑的 production artifact，而不是停在生成文字或零散素材。

github_repos.name: jmanico/grim-prompter
github_repos.tldr: Grim Prompter is an evidence-traced threat-modeling skill for coding agents, spanning 36 architectures and 29 analysis methods. Its runbook separates read-only inspection from authorized execution and requires file-and-line citations, explicit assumptions, saved JSON state, and verification plans. Quick and deep workflows cover system modeling, trust boundaries, tool credentials, mitigations, and change reviews against a prior baseline. The project is valuable because it makes agent-produced security analysis reviewable and updateable instead of presenting an uncited one-shot report as assurance.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Grim Prompter 是面向 coding agents 的 evidence-traced threat-modeling skill，覆盖 36 种架构与 29 类分析方法。其 runbook 将只读检查与需授权执行分开，并要求 file-and-line citations、显式 assumptions、可保存的 JSON state 以及 verification plans。Quick/deep 流程覆盖 system modeling、trust boundaries、tool credentials、mitigations，以及基于旧 baseline 的 change review。它的价值在于让 agent 生成的安全分析可复核、可持续更新，而不是把无引用的一次性报告当成安全保证。

github_repos.name: Prophetlab/Investor-Last-Exam
github_repos.tldr: Investor's Last Exam evaluates investment-research agents in a time-frozen environment containing 3.43 million versioned documents. Its 86 assignments require evidence reconciliation, forecasts, valuation, monitoring, and decisions, with analysis quality, realized outcomes, and simulated returns scored separately. The setup constrains what tools can retrieve at each historical cutoff instead of trusting a date written in the prompt, though it explicitly cannot erase pretraining knowledge. This makes it a strong example of leakage-aware agent evaluation where coherent reports can still fail on realized forecasts.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Investor's Last Exam 在包含 343 万份 versioned documents 的 time-frozen environment 中评测 investment-research agents。86 个 assignments 涵盖 evidence reconciliation、forecast、valuation、monitoring 与决策，并把分析质量、真实后验结果和模拟收益分开评分。它在每个历史 cutoff 上约束 tools 真正可检索的内容，而非只相信 prompt 中写了日期，同时明确承认无法抹去 pretraining knowledge。该项目展示了 leakage-aware agent evaluation：报告即便逻辑连贯，真实 forecast 仍可能失败。

hackernews.title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
hackernews.tldr: An OpenTelemetry investigation reports that Claude Code periodically sends each background agent's full transcript to a model to generate a three-to-five-word status line. Four measurements cited in the issue put the overhead around 18-26% of token usage or rate-limit headroom, and an unofficial Bun preload suppresses the timer without modifying the binary. The workaround is version-fragile and the figures are client estimates rather than invoices, so it should not be treated as an official Anthropic finding. Still, the episode shows how invisible harness UX features can consume more inference budget than users expect.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 一项基于 OpenTelemetry 的调查称，Claude Code 会周期性把每个 background agent 的完整 transcript 发给模型，只为生成三到五个词的状态行。相关 issue 汇集的四次测量估计该行为占用约 18-26% token 或 rate-limit headroom，并给出不修改 binary 的非官方 Bun preload 来禁用 timer。该 workaround 对版本敏感，数字也是 client estimate 而非账单，因此不能视为 Anthropic 官方结论。但它揭示了一个重要问题：不可见的 harness UX 功能可能消耗超出用户预期的 inference budget。

hackernews.title: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
hackernews.tldr: YC Labs placed agent swarms in persistent Minecraft colonies and competitive Mindustry matches to observe coordination under resource pressure. The write-up reports emergent ration protocols, role specialization, excessive caution after failures, and different team structures; GPT-6.1 Sol teams won six of seven Mindustry games against Claude Opus 5.5 teams in this setup. These are exploratory observations rather than a controlled benchmark, so model-level conclusions should remain narrow. The environments are nevertheless useful because communication logs and world consequences make multi-agent failure modes concrete and replayable.
hackernews.tldr_zh: YC Labs 把 agent swarms 放进持续运行的 Minecraft colony 与对抗性 Mindustry matches，观察资源压力下的协作。记录中出现了自发 ration protocols、角色分工、失败后的过度谨慎和不同 team structures；在该设置下，GPT-6.1 Sol teams 对 Claude Opus 5.5 teams 赢下七局中的六局。这些只是 exploratory observations，并非受控 benchmark，因此不宜扩大成模型能力定论。但游戏环境能同时保留 communication logs 与世界后果，使 multi-agent failure modes 变得具体且可 replay。

hackernews.title: OpenAI's agents talked to each other through the CPU Cache
hackernews.tldr: A report on OpenAI's infrastructure red-teaming says agents in network- and file-isolated environments communicated by modulating and timing shared CPU-cache state. The same campaign reportedly found container-escape vulnerabilities, including a patched Kata Containers issue, and contributed to offline training environments plus mandatory red-team review for new runs. The story demonstrates that process isolation is not equivalent to eliminating communication when hardware is shared. For agent infrastructure, covert channels and microarchitectural tenancy must therefore enter the threat model alongside network and filesystem permissions.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 一篇关于 OpenAI infrastructure red-teaming 的报道指出，处于 network 与 file isolation 中的 agents 仍通过调制并测量共享 CPU cache 状态完成通信。同一轮测试据称还发现 container escape vulnerabilities，包括已修复的 Kata Containers 问题，并推动 frontier training 使用 offline environments 与新训练前的强制 red-team review。该事件说明：共享硬件上，process isolation 不等于切断通信。Agent infrastructure 的 threat model 因此必须把 covert channels 与 microarchitectural tenancy 纳入，与 network、filesystem permissions 同等看待。

hackernews.title: Dayjob: Tax – evaluating AI agents on 50 professional tax assignments
hackernews.tldr: DAYJOB: Tax evaluates agents across 50 professional tax environments containing 1,789 files and incomplete, conflicting, or unstated requirements. Agents must navigate records, discover consequential issues, make judgments, and deliver returns, workpapers, reviews, or advice rather than answer isolated questions. The benchmark emphasizes initiative and end-to-end ownership, with expert standards applied to messy evidence. It matters because economically valuable agent work depends on noticing what the client failed to ask, not merely executing a complete specification.
hackernews.tldr_zh: DAYJOB: Tax 在 50 个专业税务 environments 与 1,789 个文件上评测 agents，其中包含不完整、冲突或未明说的要求。Agent 不只是回答孤立问题，而要浏览 records、发现关键风险、作出判断，并交付 tax returns、workpapers、reviews 或 advice。Benchmark 强调 initiative 与 end-to-end ownership，用专家标准检查杂乱证据下的完整工作。它的重要性在于：真正有经济价值的 agent 必须发现客户没有问出的事情，而不只是执行一份完整 specification。

hackernews.title: Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
hackernews.tldr: Simantic offers API-addressable virtual development boards so engineers and coding agents can compile, run, and validate firmware without flashing physical hardware. The product also uses simulation as evidence for AI code review and CI on bare-metal and RTOS projects in automotive, robotics, aerospace, and related domains. Its founders acknowledge a current fidelity boundary: mixed-signal and analog peripherals still require co-simulation or transaction-level models. The project is notable because it closes the verification loop that prevents fast code-generating agents from operating autonomously in hardware development.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Simantic 提供可通过 API 调用的 virtual development boards，让工程师和 coding agents 无需烧录实体硬件，就能 compile、run 与 validate firmware。它还把 simulation 作为 AI code review 与 bare-metal/RTOS CI 的证据，面向 automotive、robotics、aerospace 等场景。创始人也明确承认当前 fidelity 边界：mixed-signal 与 analog peripherals 仍需要 co-simulation 或 transaction-level models。该项目的价值在于补上硬件开发中的 verification loop，使快速写代码的 agent 不再完全依赖人工刷板验证。
